frontend-job-submission.h: What does the job submission form look like?
p: The form sits on your Post a Job page and asks for five things: a job title, a description, the company, how candidates should apply, and where notifications should go. Recruiters pick a company they already manage or create a new one in the same step, so a first-time employer can register, add their company and submit a listing in one sitting.

The Shortcodes Setup screen creates a Post a Job page for you, or you can place [[mjb_job_form]] on any page.
A recruiter fills it in
They choose on-site applications or an external apply URL, and the address that should hear about new applicants.
The listing is published
It goes live under your posting rules: at once with auto-approve for employer submissions, or after your review.
It runs its course
The job closes by itself when its listing duration ends, unless the recruiter marks it filled or republishes it first.

frontend-job-submission.p: Yes. The form, recruiter accounts and the recruiter dashboard are in the Free plan, which allows up to 100 active listings. Pro lifts that limit and lets you take payment before a job is published.

items: Do employers need access to wp-admin to post a job?
No. Employers post from the form on your website and manage their listings in the recruiter dashboard. They never see the WordPress admin.
Can I review jobs before they go live?
Yes. New listings can wait for your approval. If you would rather not moderate, auto-approve publishes employer submissions immediately.
Can employers send applicants to their own careers site?
Yes. Choosing External URL as the application method sends candidates to the address the employer enters instead of the on-site application form.
How does Modern Job Board deal with spam?
Applications and registrations are protected by a honeypot that is always on, optional reCAPTCHA v2 and limits on how many submissions one IP address can make.

items: Why do pretty search URLs matter for SEO?

A readable path such as /jobs/in/london/category/design/ describes the page in words that people and search engines understand. It is the same every time, so it can be linked to, shared and indexed instead of being a one-off query string.
Which fields can candidates search by?
Keyword, location, category, job type and company. Each field suggests matches as the candidate types.
Does the page reload when a filter changes?
No. The result list and its paging update in place, which keeps searching quick on slow connections and on phones.
Does job search work with any WordPress theme?
Yes. Search and listings are one shortcode, [[mjb_jobs]], with a matching block, so they sit on any page of any theme.

A candidate's overview shows profile strength, saved jobs, applications and whether recruiters can see them in the talent pool. A recruiter's overview shows how complete the company profile is, with active jobs, applications, job views and conversion.

Yes. A CV is required to create a candidate account. Candidates can keep up to eight CVs on file and change them at any time.
What does a recruiter need to sign up?

Can I approve accounts before they become active?
Yes. Turn on approval for candidates, recruiters or both, and new accounts stay pending until you approve them.
Can candidates choose which emails they receive?
Yes. Their account settings include email preferences for applications, recruiter messages and news.

private-resumes-cvs.h: Where are CVs stored, and who can open them?
p: Uploaded CVs are written to wp-content/mjb-private/, a folder outside the Media Library, and are never given a public link. A file is only sent after Modern Job Board has checked that the person asking is signed in and allowed to see it. By default, recruiters can open the CVs of candidates who applied to their own jobs; who may browse everyone else is a setting.

The file is sent

private-resumes-cvs.h: Is private CV storage in the free plan?
private-resumes-cvs.p: Yes. Private storage, checked downloads, the access levels and the anonymizer are part of every plan. Selling CV access needs Pro or Business.

items: Why not store CVs in the Media Library?

Files in the Media Library are public: anyone with the link can open them. CVs hold personal data, so Modern Job Board keeps them in a private folder and only serves them to signed-in users who are allowed to see them.
Do I need to change my server settings?
Make sure your web server refuses direct requests to wp-content/mjb-private/. On nginx that takes one rule, which the plugin's deployment guide covers.
Does this help with GDPR or POPIA?
It gives you the tools: private storage, access levels, opt-in talent profiles and an anonymizer. Whether your site complies still depends on how you collect, use and retain personal data.
Can a recruiter see the CV of someone who did not apply to them?
Only if your talent access level allows it and the candidate has chosen to be listed in the talent pool.

Each recruiter then sees what they have left on the Packages tab of their dashboard: credits, published and filled jobs, and whether resume access is active.

No. Employer payments go through your own WooCommerce store and gateway, so the revenue is yours.

Do I need WooCommerce to run a free job board?

Can I start free and add payments later?
Yes. Start on the Free plan, then move to Pro and switch on paid posting when you are ready. Your existing listings stay as they are.

A type map in the settings translates your own job types, such as Contract or Part Time, into the employment types Google for Jobs expects, and lets you set a base salary currency, value and unit.

items: What is JobPosting schema?
JobPosting is the Schema.org vocabulary for job adverts. Search engines read it to show jobs in dedicated results such as Google for Jobs, with the title, employer, location and dates.
Will my jobs definitely appear in Google for Jobs?
Structured data makes a job eligible, but Google decides what it shows. Keep jobs current, fill in salary and location, and close filled roles so your listings stay trustworthy.
Do I still need an SEO plugin?
Not for jobs: Modern Job Board adds the job markup and archive titles itself. An SEO plugin is still useful for the rest of your site.
How can I check the markup?
Use the preview in the admin, or test any job address with Google's Rich Results Test.

rest-api-feeds-webhooks-business.h: What can you build with the Modern Job Board API?
p: There are four ways to get data in and out. A public search API returns published jobs as JSON. An authenticated API gives employers their applications and analytics, and candidates their profile. An XML feed hands your listings to aggregators. Webhooks push events to your own systems the moment they happen. Together they connect a board to an ATS, a CRM, a mobile app or a data warehouse.

items: How do I authenticate with the v2 API?
Sign requests as the employer or candidate, for example with a WordPress application password. Employer routes accept the employer role or an administrator.
Can I send my jobs to aggregators such as Indeed or Jooble?
Point the aggregator at your XML feed at /feed/job-listings. Whether it accepts the feed is up to the aggregator.
How do I verify that a webhook came from my board?
Compute an HMAC-SHA256 of the raw request body with your signing secret and compare the result with the X-MJB-Signature header.
What happens if my endpoint is down?
The delivery is queued and retried up to five times, with a longer wait between attempts.

Daily or weekly, as the candidate chooses when they create the alert.
Do candidates need an account to save a job?
Yes. Saved jobs are kept in the candidate dashboard, so candidates sign in to save a job and find it again on any device.
Which candidates appear in the talent pool?
Only those who have switched on recruiter visibility in their dashboard.
Where is the alert box shown?
Under the search filters on the jobs page. You can also place it elsewhere with the [[mjb_job_alerts]] shortcode.

jobs-map-promotions.h: What does the jobs map show?
p: The jobs map plots your open jobs as markers on a Google Map, so a candidate can see at a glance where the work is. It goes on any page with one shortcode and uses your own Google Maps API key. Each job page can carry its own smaller map as well.

jobs-map-promotions.h: How do candidates share a job?

Which networks are in the share menu?

admin-dashboard-jobs-console.h: Is the admin dashboard in the free plan?
admin-dashboard-jobs-console.p: Yes. The dashboard, the jobs console and its CSV export are part of every plan. The Free plan allows up to 100 active jobs, and the Active Jobs card shows how many you are using.

items: Why are job views shown as all-time totals?
Each job keeps a running view count and not a day-by-day history, so views are reported as all-time totals whichever period is selected.
What does Board Health check?
That the job search, employer dashboard and post-a-job pages are published, that JobPosting structured data is active, that a Google Maps key is set and that search engines may index the site.
Can I export jobs to CSV?
Yes. Export Jobs on the dashboard, or the export in the jobs console, downloads the current view or the rows you have selected.
Does the admin replace the normal WordPress screens?
It gathers everything for the board in one tabbed screen. The standard WordPress editor is still there for each job.

What do candidates keep in careers mode?

Can recruiters still post jobs in careers mode?

When does a company appear in the directory?

recruiter-mcp-business.h: What is the AI assistant for recruiters?
p: It lets an employer run their hiring by chatting with an AI assistant such as ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini, instead of clicking through a dashboard. Ask “Which of my jobs have new applications?”, “Move everyone still New after 14 days to Reviewed” or “Draft an interview invitation for Sam Lee”, and the assistant does it on the board. MCP stands for Model Context Protocol, the open standard AI assistants use to work with other systems. Signed in as that employer, the assistant can list and edit their jobs, read and move their applications, update the company profile and check remaining credits. It cannot reach any other employer's records.

recruiter-mcp-business.h: Which AI assistants can I use?
p: ChatGPT, Claude and any other AI assistant that can add a custom connector. The recruiter connects it themselves in about a minute: they copy the board's address from the AI assistant tab of their dashboard, paste it into the assistant, sign in and choose Allow. From then on they simply chat. Custom connectors are only available on some ChatGPT and Claude plans.
Developer tools such as Claude Code and Gemini CLI can also connect with an application password. The AI assistant guide covers both.

recruiter-mcp-business.h: What does an MCP call look like?
recruiter-mcp-business.cap: A list_my_jobs call and the structured content it returns, shortened to one job.

items: The recruiter adds the board
They paste the address from their dashboard into ChatGPT, Claude or another assistant as a custom connector.
They sign in and choose Allow
The board's own sign-in page opens. The assistant gets a token for that recruiter, never their password.
The assistant finds the tools
It sends initialize and tools/list, then tools/call with a tool name and its arguments, as JSON-RPC.
Limits are enforced
Other employers' records, candidate logins and checkout are never available.

recruiter-mcp-business.h: Which plan includes the AI assistant for recruiters?
recruiter-mcp-business.p: Business, at $299 a year, together with the REST API, XML feed and webhooks. See pricing.

items: What is MCP?

MCP stands for Model Context Protocol. It is an open standard, now supported by the major AI assistants, that lets an assistant use tools in other systems. Modern Job Board offers its recruiter tools over MCP, so an assistant can act for an employer when they ask it to in plain English.
Do recruiters need to be technical to use it?
No. They add the board to ChatGPT or Claude as a custom connector, sign in and choose Allow, all in about a minute. After that they just chat.
Can the assistant see other employers' data?
No. Every tool is limited to the signed-in employer's own jobs, the applications to those jobs and their company.
How do I disconnect an assistant?
Open AI assistant in the recruiter dashboard and choose Disconnect. Changing the account's password, or removing its recruiter role, disconnects every assistant at once.
Does the assistant send emails by itself?
Only when the email tool is called, for interview, rejection or status emails. The outreach tool produces drafts.
How many tools are there?
Twenty, covering jobs, applications, the company profile, credits, analytics, screening and outreach.

intro.p: Modern Job Board is a job board plugin for WordPress. It runs on your own site, keeps listings, applications and CVs on your own server, and covers the whole hiring flow: posting, search, applications, employer and candidate dashboards, payments and integrations. Each feature below has its own page with screenshots and the details.

index.plans_h: Which features are in each plan?
plans: The core board: posting, predictive search, accounts and dashboards, private CVs, alerts, maps, company pages, blocks, SEO and the admin dashboard. Up to 100 active jobs.
Everything in Free with unlimited jobs, plus WooCommerce monetization, custom fields, and CSV and XML import and export.
Everything in Pro, plus the REST API, XML job feed, webhooks and the AI assistant for recruiters, so recruiters can manage hiring from ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini.
A full WordPress job board site built and configured for you, with one year of Business included, then $299 a year.
faq: Yes. The Free plan includes the core job board with up to 100 active jobs. Pro and Business are yearly plans that add monetization, data tools and integrations.
Only to take payments from employers or candidates, which is part of Pro and Business. Everything else works without it.
Where is my job board data stored?
On your own WordPress site and server. Listings, applications and CVs are not held on a third-party platform.
What do I need to run it?
WordPress 6.4 or later and PHP 7.4 or later. WooCommerce is optional.
